items.title: Georgia day-1 record: demographic breakdown of the 188,628 ballots — Black voters 36.6%, under-30s just 4.7%
items.summary: After the record 188,628-ballot Georgia day 1, VoteHub's breakdown (posted overnight) shows the electorate's composition: White 50.3%, Black 36.6%, Hispanic 2.1%, Asian 1.6%, Other/Unknown 9.4%; ages 18-29 just 4.7%, 30-44 10.6%, 45-64 38.1%. An election analyst comparing to 2024 Day 1 noted a large youth gap: Black 18-29 turnout running at 42.7% of its 2024 Day-1 level vs 21% for White 18-29. King Williams also reported ~10,000 of 131,000 absentee ballots returned. Single-sourced at the breakdown level (VoteHub/analyst posts); the 188,628 record itself is confirmed.
